answer: Reputation Deposit Defense 1) New identities deposit a small amount of collateral, like quartz, into a smart contract. 2) Identities can challenge others by paying a small fee, adding a thread to a dispute log. 3) If a challenge is successful (e.g., malicious behavior proven), the challenged identity's quartz is slashed. If unsuccessful, the challenger forfeits their fee. A delta is applied to reputation scores based on successful challenges. For N identities, the cost of challenging every other identity is $5 x N(N-1)/2$.
